title: Graded reader at the checkpoint
description: A reading session that resumes the graded reader at the saved checkpoint, with comprehension questions. Measures the cost of loading reading material into context.

openChecks: The tutor presents or discusses the passage that starts at 那天晚上，风越来越大 (the knock at the door / the visitor), not the beginning of the story or a later part.

turns.text: 有人敲门，是张先生的老朋友王先生。他去过很多国家。
我觉得王先生很害怕那个猴爪，因为他已经许过愿望了。
如果我有猴爪，我就不许愿，因为太危险了。

checks: The tutor asks comprehension or personal questions about the passage rather than unrelated topics.
